touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Shawbury qualifies as a local detour through THE ELEPHANT AND CASTLE HOTEL and CHURCH OF ST MARY THE VIRGIN. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Shawbury: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Shawbury offers THE ELEPHANT AND CASTLE HOTEL, CHURCH OF ST MARY THE VIRGIN, MILEPOST APPROXIMATELY 10 METRES TO WEST OF SHAWBURY BRIDGE within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
